name: PB_BlockFallExact
instruction: subss xmm1, xmm0 ; movss xmm0, dword ptr [rdi + 0xb20] ; subss xmm6, xmm0 ; movss dword ptr [rdi + 0xb24], xmm1 ; addss xmm1, dword ptr [rdi + 0x54] ; movss dword ptr [rdi + 0x54], xmm1
formula: BehaviorMovableBlock fall (state 1, phase 1): vy [0xB24] -= g with g = GetDelta/300 (xmm0), then pos.y += vy once per frame without the delta (2.4x too fast at 144 fps). 60 Hz per tick: v -= G; y += v (G = D/300). Exact over e ticks: y += e*v_new - g*(1-e)/2. Cave at e < 1: g -> xmm2; the first 24 bytes; xmm1 = e*vy - g*(1-e)/2; the last 10 bytes. xmm2/xmm3 dead (calls or reloads follow on every path).
